description: Ideas captured from Boss that are not yet in the backlog. Every idea gets tracked here first, then promoted to a story when prioritized.

ideas.author: Boss
ideas.title: Biz Ops MongoDB Cluster
ideas.description: Break out a dedicated MongoDB cluster for business operations (lifecycle reservations, audit trails, build counters, promotion logs). Currently these are on the frontend cluster as an interim fix. The pipeline cluster is expensive and usually off — devops state should not be there. The frontend cluster is for user-facing data — devops state should not be there either.

ideas.author: Boss
ideas.title: Unattended Agent Space on HuggingFace
ideas.description: Dedicated HuggingFace Space for unattended agent work. Runs 24/7, monitors pipelines, grooms unrealized_ideas.json, executes overnight assignments, checks semaphores. Separate from the product app — no dev pollution. Secure access via HF token. Can expose a port for webhook callbacks.

ideas.title: Daily Agent Grooming of Unrealized Ideas
ideas.description: An agent reads unrealized_ideas.json daily, cross-references with architecture and backlog, proposes solutions and roadmap placement, surfaces recommendations for morning Boss review. The Brain grooms itself.
